title: B5b v2 (respec of T-1640): fix rounds for failed execute tasks (conversion to held, crash reasons, keys, scan limits) plus fix-round note hardening
spec:
Goal T-1403, wave 3, plan label B5b v2. Replaces T-1640 (held at spec review T-1649); this spec is complete on its own and folds all ten T-1649 findings. B5 v6 (merged, f010804) handles execute_incomplete HOLDS; this task adds fix rounds for execute tasks that end with status 'failed'. Evidence: a failed luna task sat ~2 h with 16 uncommitted files; nothing files a round for a failed execute task.

Facts (goal/T-1403 with T-1637, T-1639, T-1645 merged; locate by symbol, never by line):
- failures.failure_kind: reason = lowercased hold_reason; 'execute_incomplete' holds first (partial_output scanned for environment, permissions, quota markers, else 'incomplete'); then `"conflict" in reason or "rebase_conflict" in text`, environment, permissions, quota (_QUOTA_MARKER, skipped for gate_red), invalid_spec, review code_defect, gate_red handling. failure_signature hashes pipeline.failure_kind, test ids, rejecting review comments, and for 'incomplete' the reason class, sorted dirty paths and head.
- daemon.auto_fix_round(pool): iterates bus.read(status='held', role='execute'); guards keyed on hold_reason; key = str(planner_runs._held_at(held)); chain check skips while a non-failed lineage task has fix_round_for == id; first locked block writes pipeline.failure_kind; routine rules; repeated = lineage constraints.failure_signature == signature; autonomous block (skipped for incomplete); filing locked block guarded by pipeline.auto_fix_hold_key == key; skip/notify block (auto_fix_skipped[key], quota excluded). _fix_round_spec renders fix-round.md with {incomplete_note}.
- planner_runs._held_at(t) reads the task dict's own 'events' list (no bus call). daemon._failed_at does NOT exist; this task defines it.
- Other readers of held execute tasks in daemon.py: (a) dispatch's `retry_held` list takes only hold_reason == 'budget'; a converted task keeps its crash reason, so it is inert. (b) dispatch's scheduler `running` tally and the second tally of the same shape (status in queued/held with pipeline.dispatched_at set and gated_at unset) WOULD count a converted task as in flight, because a failed task usually has dispatched_at and no gated_at. Both must skip converted tasks (item 6).
- Failed execute reasons: merge 'tests_red' (resume_hint.failures = stderr tail), rebase_conflict, spawn 'non-JSON output (rc=N): <last 500 chars of CLI output>', daemon 'dispatch error: ...', spawn 'post_result failed: ...'; supersede notes 'superseded ...', 'not run: ...', 'parent_merged', 'cancelled', 'finished by ...'. A failed task's hold_reason is None or absent. Grep spawn.py, daemon.py, merge.py, worker_control.py for the exact strings before relying on a prefix.

Change:
1. failures.failure_kind: normalised reason = (hold_reason or '').strip().lower(), or (task['reason'] or '').strip().lower() ONLY when status is 'failed' and hold_reason is empty (held tasks keep their classification exactly). All prefix tests compare against this lowercased string ('non-json output', 'dispatch error', 'post_result failed'). For those three crash prefixes: do NOT apply the `"conflict" in reason` substring check; run environment, permissions and quota marker checks, else 'incomplete'. The conflict kind applies only to hold_reason text or an exact 'rebase_conflict' reason. 'tests_red' is an alias of 'gate_red' at all gate_red comparisons (quota exemption, flaky_runs short-circuit, rerun guard): ids from resume_hint.failures; the flaky rerun runs only when the worktree exists, else 'code_defect'. Accepted risk, state it in a code comment and README: the marker scan reads untrusted CLI output, so output can only SUPPRESS a round (quota, permissions, environment are never routine: skip and notify), never cause one.
2. failures.failure_signature: the reason class for 'incomplete' comes from the same normalised reason. Crash failures with no head and no dirty set include the candidate's own id in the payload, so repeat detection never fires for them; the [daemon].auto_fix_rounds cap is the only stop.
3. daemon._failed_at(t): latest ts among t['events'] entries with status == 'failed', fallback t['created_at']; reads only the task dict, no bus call.
4. Candidates: REPLACE the existing bus.read(status='held', role='execute') call in auto_fix_round with ONE bus.read(role='execute') per pass (the snapshot); derive held candidates, failed candidates and the exclusion scan from it. Failed-task filters, cheapest first: has a parent; _failed_at newer than now - [daemon].failed_round_max_age_s (default 21600); normalised reason does not start with 'superseded', 'not run', 'parent_merged', 'cancelled', 'finished by' or 'rebase_conflict'; merged_into unset; exclusion: no execute task with status other than superseded/failed names it in constraints.fix_round_for, constraints.respec_for, constraints.finishes or inputs; the existing guards via the normalised reason (never .startswith on None); stale and lineage chain check; already_merged. The auto_fix_rounds cap per lineage applies to all.
5. Order and limits for failed candidates, oldest _failed_at first: (i) if this pass already FILED [daemon].failed_rounds_per_pass (default 2) rounds for failed candidates, defer the rest BEFORE classifying: no pipeline write, no auto_fix_skipped, no notify. (ii) For a tests_red candidate: if pipeline.flaky_rerun[key] exists, reuse that kind without rerunning; else if this pass already ran [daemon].failed_flaky_reruns_per_pass (default 1) reruns, defer silently as in (i); else classify (the rerun counts toward the rerun limit whether or not a round is then filed) and store pipeline.flaky_rerun[key] = kind in the same write as failure_kind. (iii) failure_kind runs last. routine additionally: kind 'incomplete' for a failed task; reason 'tests_red' with at least one parsed id (as gate_red). quota, permissions, environment are never routine.
6. Keys: str(_held_at(t)) for held, str(_failed_at(t)) for failed candidates; used for auto_fix_skipped and notify dedupe. pipeline.failure_kind is written for every processed (not deferred) candidate. A failed candidate that gets no round keeps status 'failed', records failure_kind and auto_fix_skipped[key], notified once per key. Dispatch's `running` tally and the second tally of the same shape skip tasks whose pipeline.prior_status == 'failed'.
7. Filed hold, silent: a held candidate whose pipeline.auto_fix_hold_key equals its current key is skipped BEFORE failure_kind, with no pipeline write, no auto_fix_skipped, no notify.
8. Filing, inside ONE bus.locked() block, in this order: (a) fresh bus.get of the candidate: status still 'failed' with the same _failed_at (or 'held' with the same _held_at), auto_fix_hold_key differs from key; (b) a FRESH bus.read(role='execute') inside the lock for the chain and exclusion re-check (never the pass snapshot), so a round filed earlier in the same pass is seen; (c) bus.create_task the round FIRST; if it raises, nothing was changed and the exception is logged, not raised; (d) for failed: one bus.update with status 'held', hold_reason = original reason VERBATIM, pipeline.prior_status 'failed', pipeline.converted_at; (e) re-read and set pipeline.auto_fix_hold_key = str(_held_at(re-read)). Crash analysis, put it in a comment: after (c) the non-failed round excludes the task (exclusion scan while failed, chain check once held), so no step order leaves a path to a duplicate round. Round 2 hangs off the round-1 child, never off the converted parent.
9. Autonomous block skipped for kind 'incomplete' and for status 'failed'; pipeline.auto_fix_route 'routine_incomplete' or 'routine_failed'.
10. Fix-round note: coerce resume_hint to a dict and dirty_in_scope / dirty_out_of_scope to lists of str before rendering and hashing; list at most the first 50 dirty paths, each cut to 200 chars, then '(+N more)'; the incomplete framing says it overrides the template's closing line 'Implement the smallest fix within the task scope and verify all acceptance criteria.' for this round and adds: if git status or git diff fails in the held worktree, redo the work from the acceptance. That closing line stays the last line of fix-round.md. An empty {incomplete_note} renders byte-identical to the template with the placeholder replaced by ''.
11. README.md: the three new [daemon] keys with defaults; the conversion (failed -> held, pipeline.prior_status); crash failures rely on the cap, and a flapping environment costs up to failed_rounds_per_pass rounds per pass until each lineage hits the cap or the 6 h age window; the marker-scan accepted risk; manual rollback for converted tasks (bus.update status 'failed', hold_reason None, clear prior_status, converted_at, auto_fix_hold_key together) and that superseding a queued round first needs the human's approval. No rollback script.

Stop rule: before editing, grep daemon.py, worker_control.py, spawn.py, merge.py and planner_runs.py for every reader of held execute tasks. If any reader other than the two tallies in item 6 would respawn, re-dispatch, orphan-handle or budget-count a converted task and fixing it needs a file outside scope, make no commit for that part: stop and report the reader by symbol in the result. List each reader and why it is inert in the commit message.

Tests that assert the old behaviour (SPEC RULE): existing tests in tests/test_failures.py and tests/test_daemon.py pass unchanged, except tests that expected a held task to escalate when its filed round later failed (item 7) and tests that pin the bus.read(status='held', role='execute') call: update those and name them in the commit message. Commit first, then run in the foreground: tests/test_failures.py, tests/test_daemon.py, tests/test_decision.py, tests/test_gate_timeout.py, tests/test_steering_policy.py, tests/test_planner_runs*.py, tests/test_specialist.py, tests/test_spawn.py; if one outside scope fails, stop and report instead of editing it. Never background a command; never run the full gate.

Out of scope: spawn.py, merge.py, planner_runs.py, decision.py, worker_control.py (tests may import planner_runs read-only). Rollback: git revert of the merge commit, then the README steps for converted tasks.

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1403. Write tests as unittest.TestCase methods using tests/_harness.py like the neighbouring tests; never module-level test functions; every task dict in a test has a unique 'id'. Simulate the in-lock race by patching bus.get so the re-read returns the task superseded. Every test named in the acceptance must exist in the diff.
acceptance: tests/test_failures.py::test_failure_kind_for_failed_crash_and_tests_red_reasons: passes: a failed task (hold_reason None) with reason 'non-JSON output (rc=143): merge conflict in output' classifies 'incomplete'; with reason '  Non-JSON output (rc=1): usage limit reached' it classifies 'quota' (strip and lowercase); 'dispatch error: boom' and 'post_result failed: x' classify 'incomplete'; reason 'rebase_conflict' classifies 'conflict'; reason 'tests_red' with resume_hint.failures naming one Python test id classifies 'code_defect', or 'flaky' when a rerun passes, and 'code_defect' when the worktree is missing; a HELD task whose hold_reason is empty and whose reason field is set keeps its pre-change classification

tests/test_failures.py::test_failure_signature_for_failed_crash_reasons: passes: two failed crash tasks with identical reason and no head or dirty set but different ids have different signatures; the incomplete signature reads the reason class from the failed task's reason when hold_reason is None; signatures of gate_red and execute_incomplete holds are unchanged for the same input

tests/test_daemon.py::test_auto_fix_round_files_rounds_for_failed_execute_tasks: passes: daemon._failed_at returns the latest status=failed event ts from the task's events and created_at without one; auto_fix_round files 'fix round 1' for a failed task with reason 'non-JSON output (rc=143): ' (converted to held with hold_reason equal to that reason verbatim, pipeline.prior_status 'failed', auto_fix_route 'routine_failed') and for a failed tests_red task with parsed test ids; files nothing and raises nothing for failed tasks whose reason starts with 'superseded', 'not run', 'parent_merged', 'cancelled', 'finished by' or 'rebase_conflict', for one older than failed_round_max_age_s, for one named by another execute task's fix_round_for, respec_for, constraints.finishes or inputs, or for one already merged; a second pass files nothing; with [planner].autonomous True and routes enabled the failed round is still filed; a pass with no filing calls bus.read exactly once, with role='execute' and no status

tests/test_daemon.py::test_auto_fix_round_failed_candidates_keys_limits_and_round_two: passes: a failed candidate with a quota kind keeps status 'failed', gets failure_kind and auto_fix_skipped keyed by str(daemon._failed_at(task)) and no notify; a non-routine permissions candidate is notified once across two passes; with three eligible failed tasks and failed_rounds_per_pass 2, pass one files the two oldest and writes nothing on the third, pass two files the third; with two failed tests_red candidates and failed_flaky_reruns_per_pass 1 only one rerun runs per pass, and a candidate whose pipeline.flaky_rerun holds its current key is not rerun again; a round-1 child that ends failed gets 'fix round 2' with fix_round_for the child and auto_fix_rounds 2 stops round 3; an in-lock re-read returning the task superseded files nothing

tests/test_daemon.py::test_auto_fix_round_conversion_order_and_inert_readers: passes: when bus.create_task raises, the failed candidate keeps status 'failed' with no prior_status and the pass does not raise; when the in-lock fresh bus.read shows a non-failed execute task naming the candidate in fix_round_for that the pass snapshot lacked, nothing is filed; a converted task (status held, pipeline.prior_status 'failed', dispatched_at set, gated_at unset) is not counted by dispatch's running tally and is not in retry_held

tests/test_daemon.py::test_auto_fix_round_skips_filed_hold_silently: passes: a held task whose pipeline.auto_fix_hold_key equals its current held key and whose round child has failed gets no failure_kind write, no auto_fix_skipped entry and no notify on the next pass; the planner_runs held decision-point generator, imported and called from this test, yields nothing for a converted task while its round is queued

tests/test_daemon.py::test_fix_round_note_caps_dirty_paths_and_overrides_gate_line: passes: an incomplete round for a hold with 60 dirty paths lists 50 paths and '(+10 more)', a 300-char path is cut to 200 chars, a resume_hint whose dirty_in_scope is a string or None renders without error, the note says it overrides the closing verify line and names the redo-from-acceptance fallback; a gate_red round's rendered text equals the template rendered with an empty incomplete_note, and the last line of .orchestrator/prompts/fix-round.md is 'Implement the smallest fix within the task scope and verify all acceptance criteria.'
